item.title: German exit polls suggest far-right party has big lead in regional election
item.description: Exit polls show Germany's AfD taking a commanding lead in a regional election, but it remains unclear whether the far-right party can form the country's first state government since World War II.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover
item.description: Even as anti-Muslim rhetoric rises in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are winning over diners and reshaping one of the state's most iconic culinary traditions.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
item.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.

item.title: Trump administration to dig at triumphal arch site despite no final federal approvals
item.description: The Trump administration says it will break ground on a 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., without final federal approval and despite an ongoing lawsuit.
